testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.patchloop.PatchLoopSimpleApiIntegrationTest

testcase.name: POST /execute with evidence config passes through correctly
POST /execute with autofix_loop mode enables retesting
POST /execute returns 400 for invalid execution mode
POST /execute-graph without iterationId creates new execution (non-regression)
POST /execute delegates to graph orchestrator and returns execution details (E6.5)
POST /execute persists all new E6.5 request fields
POST /execute-graph with custom mermaid preserves graph (non-regression)
POST /execute returns 400 for missing required fields
